Here’s a quick guide to building a well‑rounded leg workout. Feel free to mix and match based on your goals (strength, hypertrophy, endurance, mobility) and the equipment you have. | Exercise | Primary Muscles Targeted | Equipment Needed | Typical Sets/Reps | Modifications / Variations | |----------|--------------------------|------------------|-------------------|----------------------------| | **Back Squat** | Quadriceps, glutes, hamstrings, core | Barbell + squat rack | 3–5 × 4–8 | Front squat, goblet squat, box squat | | **Front Squat** | Quads, core, upper back | Barbell + squat rack | 3–5 × 4–8 | Zercher squat, dumbbell front squat | | **Sumo Squat** | Inner thighs, glutes, quads | Dumbbell or kettlebell | 3–4 × 8–12 | Sumo goblet squat, sumo barbell squat | | **Bulgarian Split Squat** | Quads, glutes, hamstrings | Bench or step | 3–4 × 6–10 per leg | Walking split squat, weighted split squat | | **Lunges** | Quads, glutes, hamstrings | Bodyweight, dumbbells, barbell | 3–4 × 8–12 per leg | Reverse lunge, walking lunge, curtsy lunge | | **Deadlift (Conventional)** | Hamstrings, glutes, lower back | Barbell | 3–5 × 4–8 | Romanian deadlift, sumo deadlift, trap bar deadlift | | **Romanian Deadlift** | Hamstrings, glutes | Barbell or dumbbells | 3–4 × 6–10 | Stiff‑legged deadlift, single‑leg RDL | | **Hip Thrust / Glute Bridge** | Glutes, hamstrings | Barbell, resistance band | 3–4 × 8–15 | Single‑leg bridge, banded hip thrust | | **Leg Press** | Quads, glutes, hamstrings | Leg press machine | 3–4 × 8–12 | Narrow stance, wide stance, single‑leg press | | **Calf Raise (Standing/Seated)** | Calves (gastrocnemius, soleus) | Bodyweight, dumbbells, calf raise machine | 3–4 × 12–20 | Seated calf raise, single‑leg calf raise | | **Hamstring Curl** | Hamstrings | Machine or stability ball | 3–4 × 8–12 | Swiss ball hamstring curl, Nordic curl | | **Step‑Up** | Quads, glutes, hamstrings | Bench or sturdy box | 3–4 × 8–12 per leg | Weighted step‑up, lateral step‑up | | **Wall Sit** | Quads, glutes | Wall | 3–4 × 30–60 sec | Weighted wall sit, wall sit with pulse | | **Box Jump / Plyometric Jump** | Quads, glutes, calves, power | Plyo box | 3–4 × 6–10 | Low box jump, depth jump, bounding | --- ### Sample Weekly Routine (3‑day split) | Day | Warm‑up | Main Workout | Cool‑down | |-----|---------|--------------|-----------| | **Day 1 – Strength Focus** | 5 min light cardio + dynamic stretches | 1. Back squat 5×5
2. Romanian deadlift 4×6
3. Walking lunge 3×12 per leg
4. Calf raise 4×15 | Stretch quads, hamstrings, calves | | **Day 2 – Hypertrophy & Endurance** | 5 min rowing + leg swings | 1. Front squat 4×8
2. Bulgarian split squat 3×10 per leg
3. Leg press 4×12
4. Hip thrust 3×15 | Stretch glutes, quads, hamstrings | | **Day 3 – Power & Mobility** | 5 min jump rope + hip circles | 1. Box jump 4×6
2. Sumo deadlift 4×6
3. Step‑up 3×12 per leg
4. Wall sit 3×45 sec | Foam roll calves, quads, glutes | *Adjust volume and intensity based on your experience level.* For beginners, start with 2–3 sets of 8–12 reps; for advanced lifters, aim for 4–5 sets of 4–8 reps for strength moves and 3–4 sets of 8–15 reps for hypertrophy. --- ### Safety Tips 1. **Warm up properly** – 5–10 min of light cardio + dynamic leg swings, hip circles, ankle rolls. 2. **Use proper form** – Keep your chest up, knees tracking over toes, avoid rounding the lower back. 3. **Progress gradually** – Increase load by ~5 % once you can complete all reps with good form. 4. **Listen to your body** – If you feel sharp pain (not just soreness), stop and reassess technique or consult a professional. 5. **Cool down & stretch** – Static stretching after the workout helps maintain flexibility and reduce soreness. --- ### Quick Reference Cheat Sheet - **Squats** – Core, quads, glutes, hamstrings. - **Deadlifts** – Hamstrings, glutes, lower back. - **Lunges** – Quads, glutes, hamstrings. - **Hip Thrusts** – Glutes, hamstrings. - **Calf Raises** – Calves. - **Leg Press** – Quads, glutes, hamstrings. - **Step‑Ups** – Quads, glutes, hamstrings. Feel free to ask if you’d like a more detailed program tailored to a specific goal (e.g., marathon training, bodybuilding, rehab). Happy lifting!
